name: Earthjustice
summary: The largest US non-profit environmental law firm: free legal representation for community, health and environmental groups and tribes, in courts, before agencies and state utility commissions, on clean energy and climate, toxic air and water pollution, and endangered species, public lands and oceans.

spending.source: https://earthjustice.org/document/2025-audited-financials (audited financial statements, June 30, 2025 and 2024, Statement of Functional Expenses for the year to June 30, 2025, p. 5: program services $154,189,060 (litigation $96,461,613, public information $57,727,447, each including donated services; $16,809,973 in all) of total expenses $183,685,874)

lines.label: Climate and clean energy: federal climate rules, coal and gas plants before state utility commissions, fossil-fuel leasing, international coal and gas cases
lines.source: https://earthjustice.org/document/2025-audited-financials (p. 5): 45% of program services of $154,189,060 (facts/earthjustice.json climate_share, our judgment; the accounts split programmes only into litigation and public information, across the three focus areas named in note 1), year to June 30, 2025. One line: litigation and public information on climate are branches of one model.

lines.label: Healthy communities: national air standards, chemical plants and refineries, drinking water, pesticides, coal ash, community enforcement
lines.source: https://earthjustice.org/document/2025-audited-financials (p. 5): 25% of program services of $154,189,060 (facts/earthjustice.json health_share, our judgment), year to June 30, 2025.

lines.label: Biodiversity: endangered species, public lands and forests, oceans and marine monuments
